checks.name: Entity clarity
checks.why: AI engines need to understand what entity the site represents before they can confidently recommend or cite it.

findings.summary: Your business identity is not packaged for AI engines.
findings.evidence: No Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD was found on the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Add structured data that states the business name, URL, description, logo, sameAs profiles, and contact details.

findings.summary: The homepage does not clearly summarize what the business does.
findings.recommendation: Write a plain-English 150–170 character description that says who you help, what you sell, and where/for whom.

findings.summary: AI answers need corroborating entity pages.
findings.evidence: About page detected: false. Contact page detected: false.
findings.recommendation: Expose obvious About and Contact pages in the main navigation so crawlers can verify the entity.

checks.name: Answer citation readiness
checks.why: AI engines cite pages that directly answer natural-language questions with specific facts, comparisons, and proof.

findings.summary: The site lacks a question-and-answer page AI engines can quote.
findings.evidence: No FAQ or question-led page was detected in the crawled pages.
findings.recommendation: Create an FAQ answering buying questions in complete, citation-friendly sentences.

findings.summary: There is little content for “best / cost / compare” AI-search prompts.
findings.evidence: No crawled page contained strong comparison, pricing, alternative, or case-study language.
findings.recommendation: Publish one page that directly answers how to choose, compare, and budget for this type of business.

findings.summary: Claims are hard to cite because proof points are not explicit.
findings.evidence: No concrete numbers such as years, locations, reviews, prices, or client counts were detected.
findings.recommendation: Add verifiable proof points near service claims.

checks.name: Crawler extractability
checks.why: An AI engine cannot cite what it cannot crawl, parse, or identify as the primary page.

findings.evidence: No rel="canonical" tags were found in fetched pages.
findings.recommendation: Add canonical tags to clarify the preferred URL for each page.
